[F005] All three findings addressed.

**Finding 1 (high, correctness — acceptance 7 violated by the gate-pause emitter).** Reverted it. `supervisor._emit_gate_paused_discord` no longer builds a `pause_metadata` dict or passes `technical_metadata` on the `gate_paused` event (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/supervisor.py:500`), so the rendered approval command is `dontpanic approve <plan> implement` again — byte-identical to the pre-change tree. The comment at that site now states the defect plainly (the emitter carries only the stage, so `{gate}` resolves through the subtype alias) and points at plan 2026-08-10-001 F001/F002, which owns the command change. The renderer's ability to read explicit `gate` / `pending_gates` metadata is kept for that plan to publish into, and its comment in `event_copy._reference_gate_stage` was corrected — it previously claimed the pause emitter publishes both keys, which is now false.

**Finding 2 (high, test_coverage — the baseline hardcodes metadata production never sent).** Closed with a second, emitter-level baseline. `tests/tools/f005_emitter_command_probe.py` drives the eight live emit sites (three gate-pause shapes, two breakers, three budget kinds) and records what `render()` produces for the payloads they actually build; it is standalone and calls only pre-change-compatible signatures so the identical file runs in either tree. `fixtures/f005_prechange_emitter_commands.json` is that capture taken inside a `git worktree` of HEAD 3d037ef, and `test
